purpose: Candidate auxiliary point-annotation evaluation of CrowdSight crowd/person detection; not an approved or scored held-out evaluation.

source.annotation_type: per-frame head points (frame_id,x,y), not person boxes
source.sequence_unit: sequence folder containing 30 ordered frame images

permission.reason: No license or terms file was found in the extracted package or archive; obtain a source-specific permission/license record before inference, transformed annotation use, or redistribution.

independence.note: The 76 selected sequences are outside the six sequences recorded in the previous best.pt DroneCrowd comparison, but complete upstream checkpoint/source independence is not established.

sampling.selection_rule: Every sequence in the local 82-sequence trainlist except the six IDs in prior_comparison_excluded_sequence_ids.
sampling.frame_rule: All 30 labeled frame IDs, 1 through 30, in each selected sequence.
